annotations.title: Section 8 HAP contracts paying under Fair Market Rent

description: The deal screen's rent test for one state: active Section 8 HAP contracts whose rent-to-FMR ratio in HUD's file is above zero and under a threshold (default 90%), with property, assisted units, ratio, both expiration dates and a prefilled offer-calculator link. Optional filters: county, city, minimum assisted units, overall expiration within N months.

county.description: Optional county name as HUD spells it, e.g. "Cuyahoga".

expiring_within_months.description: Optional: only contracts whose overall expiration falls within this many months of the HUD file date.

limit.description: Rows to return, 1 to 20 (default 10); page with offset for more.

max_rent_to_fmr.description: Keep contracts whose rent-to-FMR ratio is under this percent (default 90, the deal screen's line).

min_assisted_units.description: Optional minimum assisted units (the state page table uses 20).

sort.description: Lowest ratio first (default), largest first, or soonest overall expiration first.

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code, e.g. OH.
